text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Mejiro McQueen was,
I decided to take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
J-Jeez...
You really don't need to keep such close watch over me.
I'm not a child, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, if you stare at me like that,
well... I won't even be able to fall asleep."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"You must be just as exhausted as I am.
Now, now! Go on and get some rest in your room."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Where is this...?
...Could I be dreaming?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Is that over there... a plushie?
Somehow, it looks familiar...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Usarina...!
The doll Grandmother gave me so long ago...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so nostalgic... We'd sleep together,
and it always comforted me when I was lonely with a cold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When we parted ways because they were moving,
I was so sad that I cried all night long...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've... grown quite a bit, you know.
Much more than back when I was frail and such a crybaby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Besides... that dream I had back then
has now turned into pure determination.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, achieving a flawless victory would—...!

Hearing Mejiro McQueen's words,
Usariina seemed to flash a bright smile.

And in the next instant,
a dazzling light filled the entire area—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I slept great and woke up feeling wonderful.
I feel power welling up inside me!

Her energy restored, Mejiro McQueen
left the infirmary with a light step.

Perhaps Mejiro McQueen's voice didn't reach it,
because Usariinu just sat there without moving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry.
Talking only about myself... Um, well... er...
While I hesitated, a dazzling light filled the surroundings—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah... Is this the infirmary?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Which means what just happened was, after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
That was rather a sorrowful dream...
Unable to get the dream out of her head, Mejiro McQueen was unable to get enough rest.
